mapper.sql: select r.record_id, r.visitor_uid, r.questionnaire_id, r.profile_id, r.request_json, r.result_json, r.match_rule_json, r.top_plant_id, p.plant_name as top_plant_name, r.total_candidate_count, r.result_count, r.source_terminal, r.recommend_time from zx_recommend_record r left join zx_plant p on r.top_plant_id = p.plant_id
mapper.select: select i.item_id, i.record_id, i.plant_id, p.plant_name, i.score_total, i.score_detail_json, i.rank_num, i.reason_text, i.create_time from zx_recommend_item i left join zx_plant p on i.plant_id = p.plant_id where i.record_id = #{recordId} order by i.rank_num asc, i.item_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into zx_recommend_record (visitor_uid, questionnaire_id, profile_id, request_json, result_json, match_rule_json, top_plant_id, total_candidate_count, result_count, source_terminal, recommend_time) values (#{visitorUid}, #{questionnaireId}, #{profileId}, #{requestJson}, #{resultJson}, #{matchRuleJson}, #{topPlantId}, #{totalCandidateCount}, #{resultCount}, #{sourceTerminal}, #{recommendTime})

insert into zx_recommend_item (record_id, plant_id, score_total, score_detail_json, rank_num, reason_text, create_time) values
(#{item.recordId}, #{item.plantId}, #{item.scoreTotal}, #{item.scoreDetailJson}, #{item.rankNum}, #{item.reasonText}, sysdate())
